descriptor.listSeparator: ECMAScript whitespace and line terminators: trim, split on /\s+/, discard empty tokens; retain order and source spans. Includes U+00A0 and U+000B, not only HTML ASCII whitespace.
descriptor.compoundKeys: alt, ctrl, meta and shift joined with + to a key filter; pinned codec also admits the modifier+event form
descriptor.dottedNonKeyboardEvents: Keep the dot suffix in the event name, not a keyboard filter.
descriptor.shorthand: Event omission is valid only when the element has a pinned default event.
descriptor.malformed: Typed error parts preserve exact source spans; never drop a malformed token.
descriptor.customizations: Statically registered custom schema keys/options are conditional facts; computed customizations stay unknown. Never execute them.

options.negation: ! sets the option value to false; not limited to !passive

keyFilters.alphabet: a through z map to themselves

valueTypes.decode: JSON array only; reject another JSON kind
false only for 0 or case-insensitive false; every other string is true
Remove underscores, then ECMAScript Number conversion; NaN is a non-coercible static fact, not a thrown decoder error

attributeFamilies.name: data-{identifier}-{name}-value
attributeFamilies.value: literal value decoded against static values

attributeFamilies.name: data-{identifier}-{name}-class
attributeFamilies.value: CSS class tokens; conditional usage, not a definite selector match

attributeFamilies.name: data-{identifier}-{outletIdentifier}-outlet
attributeFamilies.value: CSS selector delegated to shared selector parser

attributeFamilies.name: data-{identifier}-{name}-param
attributeFamilies.value: JSON typecast when valid, otherwise string; params come from attributes on the element carrying the action's data-action descriptor, matched to its controller identifier, with camelized parameter names

attributeFamilies.name: data-target
attributeFamilies.value: legacy identifier.name tokens accepted by pinned defaultSchema
attributeFamilies.disposition: compatibility fact inside the admitted release; never activates a legacy framework profile

declarations: static values (constructor, literal default or type/default object; see valueDeclarationForms)
loader convention backed by resolved registration facts

valueDeclarationForms.constructor: Symbol-proven Array, Boolean, Number, Object or String; type and built-in default come from valueTypes. Example: count: Number gives number with default 0.
valueDeclarationForms.literalDefault: Boolean, number, string, array or plain object literal; infer its valueTypes kind and retain the literal as its custom default. Examples: count: 0, enabled: false, label: 'hello', items: [], options: {}. An object with type/default fields follows the pinned configuration-object rules first.
valueDeclarationForms.typeDefaultObject: Configuration object with type, default or both. Example: count: { type: Number, default: 0 }; a supplied default must match the declared type. Type-only uses the built-in default; default-only infers the kind from the default.
valueDeclarationForms.staticBoundary: Use shared symbol and literal facts only. Computed expressions, calls, spreads or unresolved constructor/configuration bindings retain unknown type/default parts; never execute them. All admitted forms contribute the same generated value member names through TypeInfo.

boundaries: No Stimulus parser: descriptor codecs over HWC2 facts
No template parser: ERBH1 holes stay unknown
Generated members are TypeInfo facts; never inject declarations into tsgo
this.dispatch contributes DOM-event facts, never a component events facet
